description: This file defines WebSocket message types, events, responses, and related structures for the Mattermost server, including event types, broadcast mechanisms, JSON serialization, and event handling logic.

classes.name: WebsocketBroadcast
classes.description: Represents a broadcast message configuration for WebSocket events, including filtering options and hooks.

classes.name: precomputedWebSocketEventJSON
classes.description: Stores precomputed JSON serialization of WebSocket event components for efficiency.

classes.name: webSocketEventJSON
classes.description: Serializable structure mirroring WebSocketEvent for JSON encoding.

classes.name: WebSocketEvent
classes.description: Represents a WebSocket event with methods for JSON serialization, copying, and validation.

classes.name: WebSocketResponse
classes.description: Represents a response to a WebSocket request, including status, data, and error information.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of WebsocketBroadcast.

methods.name: AddHook
methods.description: Adds a hook ID and arguments to the WebsocketBroadcast.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of precomputedWebSocketEventJSON.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of webSocketEventJSON.

methods.name: PrecomputeJSON
methods.description: Precomputes and caches JSON serialization of the WebSocketEvent.

methods.name: RemovePrecomputedJSON
methods.description: Removes cached JSON serialization from the WebSocketEvent.

methods.name: WithoutBroadcastHooks
methods.description: Returns a copy of the event without broadcast hooks and their arguments.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the event's data.

methods.name: NewWebSocketEvent
methods.description: Constructs a new WebSocketEvent with specified parameters.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of the WebSocketEvent.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the WebSocketEvent.

methods.name: GetData
methods.description: Returns the data map of the event.

methods.name: GetBroadcast
methods.description: Returns the broadcast configuration of the event.

methods.name: GetSequence
methods.description: Returns the sequence number of the event.

methods.name: SetEvent
methods.description: Returns a copy of the event with a new event type.

methods.name: SetData
methods.description: Returns a copy of the event with new data.

methods.name: SetBroadcast
methods.description: Returns a copy of the event with a new broadcast configuration.

methods.name: SetSequence
methods.description: Returns a copy of the event with a new sequence number.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the event has a valid (non-empty) event type.

methods.name: EventType
methods.description: Returns the event type of the WebSocketEvent.

methods.name: ToJSON
methods.description: Serializes the WebSocketEvent to JSON, using precomputed cache if available.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Encodes the WebSocketEvent into a JSON encoder.

methods.name: precomputedJSONBuf
methods.description: Returns the precomputed JSON bytes of the event.

methods.name: WebSocketEventFromJSON
methods.description: Deserializes JSON data into a WebSocketEvent.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a key-value pair to the response data.

methods.name: NewWebSocketResponse
methods.description: Creates a new WebSocketResponse with specified status, sequence, and data.

methods.name: NewWebSocketError
methods.description: Creates a new error response for WebSocket.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the response has a valid (non-empty) status.

methods.name: EventType
methods.description: Returns the event type for responses, which is 'response'.

methods.name: ToJSON
methods.description: Serializes the WebSocketResponse to JSON.

methods.name: WebSocketResponseFromJSON
methods.description: Deserializes JSON data into a WebSocketResponse.

methods.name: Reject
methods.description: Marks the WebSocketEvent as rejected.

methods.name: IsRejected
methods.description: Checks if the WebSocketEvent has been rejected.
